title: Product over a fixed base of affine morphisms is affine
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X'\to S$, $X\to S$, $T'\to S$, $T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes, and let $a:X'\to X$ and $c:T'\to T$ be morphisms over $S$ (commuting with the maps to $S$). If $a$ and $c$ are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], then the induced morphism $a\times_Sc:X'\times_ST'\to X\times_ST$ of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] (with components $a\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$ and $c\circ\mathrm{pr}_2$) is affine.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas 01SD (morphisms-lemma-base-change-affine, line 1982) and 01SC (morphisms-lemma-composition-affine, line 1970): a x_S c is the composite of X' x_S T' -> X x_S T' (base change of a along X x_S T' -> X) and X x_S T' -> X x_S T (base change of c along X x_S T -> T)
